title: Introduce Phase Kick Back in Wave Propagation
full_prompt: Write a ManimGL script that visualizes a wave propagating through multiple boundary layers, where each layer introduces a phase shift ('phase kick back') and amplitude damping (absorption). Implement a custom `SlicedWave` group that contains an `OscillatingWave` (a VMobject whose points are updated dynamically via an updater function), vertical lines representing the boundaries, and `ValueTracker`s to control the phase shift and damping at each boundary. The wave's y-coordinate should be computed dynamically based on its x-coordinate, time, and the cumulative phase shifts and damping factors from all boundaries to the left of the point. Ensure the wave updates smoothly over time using `add_updater`.

visual_techniques: Dynamic wave propagation with custom updaters
Boundary-based phase shifting and amplitude damping

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect phase shift calculation leading to discontinuous wave segments at boundaries
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure the cumulative phase shift and damping are correctly applied to all points to the right of each boundary using vectorized numpy operations.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Updater function failing to update points dynamically over time
common_failure_modes.note: The updater must correctly increment time and re-evaluate the wave's coordinates using the current ValueTracker states.
